fact: Finance minister Peggy Serame said BURS continues to optimise e-services including online customs declarations.

BURS's Principal Officer for Customs Reforms says a new integrated Customs Management System replaced ASYCUDA++ in 2017 and clears declarations after online payment through the declaration processing platform.
BURS says the CMS provides a Single Window through its Other Government Agencies module, with the Botswana Bureau of Standards enrolled and other agencies at testing stage.
